designer_notes.height_gimmick: The only cheap ascent is the road pass along the southern rows (elevation 0→3 in single steps); the cliff face jumps 2–4 levels per tile and is unclimbable for Jump 2 units, so the shelf archer out-ranges anyone who refuses the long way around. Exists to exercise every elevation-related validator check.
designer_notes.witness_setup: One thrall shepherd grazing by the road pass; ai flee toward the east escape edge. The player can hold the pass mouth (the e3 tile) to cut the flight line and keep the battle Unsung — or let the shepherd run and be Sung. Exists to exercise witness/escape-edge validation.
designer_notes.intent: Phase 0 validator self-test. Touches every schema section: overlays, neutrals, named enemy, triggers with set_flag and flag registry cross-ref, escape edges, secondary objectives. Not a shipping battle; retire with data/maps/example/ once ch1 maps land.
